title.zh: AI 是怎么把一团噪声变成一张图的
title.en: How a Machine Turns Noise into a Picture

desc.zh: 从“生成就是抽样”讲到扩散模型和流匹配：加噪、分数、去噪、DDPM 与 DDIM、概率流、流匹配与再拉直、无分类器引导、潜空间，以及截至 2026 年 11 月的前沿。每个模型都在页面里真的运行。
desc.en: From "generating is sampling" to diffusion and flow models: noising, the score, denoising, DDPM and DDIM, the probability-flow ODE, flow matching and reflow, classifier-free guidance, latent space, and the frontier as of November 2026. Every model really runs in the page.

title.zh: 生成就是抽样：维数灾难
title.en: Generation is sampling: the curse of dimension

desc.zh: 生成一张图就是从图像的概率分布里抽一个样；直接拒绝抽样在二维还能留下 3.4%，到 784 维只剩约 10⁻³⁹⁵。
desc.en: Making an image means drawing from the distribution of images; plain rejection sampling keeps 3.4% in two dimensions and about 10⁻³⁹⁵ in 784.

zh: 生成式 AI 是什么
为什么不能随机生成图片
en: how does AI image generation work
why can't you just generate random pixels

desc.zh: 一步步往数据里加一点高斯噪声，1000 步后任何图都变成同一团标准正态噪声，而且任意一步都有一步到位的公式。
desc.en: Add a little Gaussian noise step by step; after 1,000 steps any image becomes the same standard normal noise, and every step has a closed form.

en: how does a diffusion model add noise

desc.zh: 分数是对数密度的梯度，像指向数据的箭头；顺着它走再加点噪声就能抽样，但只在先模糊后变清楚（退火）时比例才对。
desc.en: The score is the gradient of log-density, an arrow towards the data; following it with added noise samples the distribution, but the proportions come out right only when annealed from blurry to sharp.

en: what is the score in diffusion models

title.zh: 去噪目标、后验均值与 Tweedie 公式
title.en: The denoising objective, the posterior mean and Tweedie's formula

desc.zh: 训练网络猜加进去的噪声；最优的猜测是一个条件平均，它等于分数乘以一个常数，所以学去噪就是学分数。
desc.en: Train a network to guess the added noise; the best guess is a conditional average equal to the score times a constant, so learning to denoise is learning the score.

title.zh: DDPM 与 DDIM：步数和质量
title.en: DDPM vs DDIM: steps against quality

desc.zh: 从噪声倒着走回数据；每步加新噪声的 DDPM 在这个问题上要 100 步，不加噪声的 DDIM 50 步，步数补不了网络本身的误差。
desc.en: Walk back from noise to data; DDPM, which adds fresh noise each step, needs 100 steps here and the deterministic DDIM 50, and more steps cannot fix the network's own error.

zh: 扩散模型怎么生成图片

title.zh: 概率流、流匹配与再拉直
title.en: Probability flow, flow matching and rectified flow

desc.zh: 去噪可以写成一条确定的流；流匹配直接学直线路径上的速度，再拉直一次后一步就够。
desc.en: Denoising can be written as a deterministic flow; flow matching learns velocities along straight paths, and after one reflow a single step is enough.

zh: 为什么新模型步数更少
en: why do newer models need fewer steps

desc.zh: 把“有条件”和“无条件”的方向之差放大，样本更像所要的类别，却更挤、更不全；引导强度是像不像与多不多样的取舍。
desc.en: Amplifying the difference between conditional and unconditional directions makes samples look more like the requested class but less varied; guidance trades fidelity for diversity.

zh: 为什么 CFG 调高图会变怪

title.zh: 完美的去噪器只会抄：记忆与泛化
title.en: A perfect denoiser only copies: memorisation and generalisation

desc.zh: 在有限训练集上，去噪目标的精确最优解只会复制训练点；网络没学到这个最优解，才生成新东西。
desc.en: On a finite training set the exact optimum of the denoising objective reproduces training points; networks generate new samples because they do not reach that optimum.

zh: AI 画图会复制原图吗
en: do diffusion models copy training data

desc.zh: 先用自编码器把 512×512 的图压成 64×64×4 的潜表示（少 48 倍），再在潜空间里去噪，文字通过交叉注意力指挥每个位置。
desc.en: An autoencoder squeezes a 512×512 image into a 64×64×4 latent (48× smaller); denoising happens there, and text steers every position through cross-attention.

en: how text-to-image models read the prompt

title.zh: 图像与视频生成的前沿（2026 年 11 月）
title.en: The image and video generation frontier (November 2026)

desc.zh: 扩散 Transformer 与流匹配成为主流结构，少步生成快速进展；评估、可控性、记忆和版权仍是没解决的问题。
desc.en: Diffusion transformers and flow matching dominate, few-step generation is advancing fast, and evaluation, control, memorisation and copyright remain open.
